subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth attention in these incident descriptions.

judge.implied_focus: Which incidents warrant prioritized attention (severity/urgency signals derived from incident descriptions)

per_column.name: has_critical_keyword
per_column.rationale: Flags descriptions containing critical-severity language, a direct signal of attention-worthiness.

per_column.name: issue_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the incident domain, giving a facet to segment where attention is concentrated (Email, Database, VPN, etc.).

per_column.name: issue_frequency_rank
per_column.rationale: Encodes how common each issue type is, helping identify high-volume clusters worth attention; mildly redundant with issue_type but adds a prioritization dimension.

per_column.name: contains_outage_signal
per_column.rationale: Detects outage-related language, another concrete severity/impact indicator feeding attention.

per_column.name: attention_score
per_column.rationale: An aggregate composite that directly operationalizes the focus, ranking incidents by how much attention they merit.

judge.rationale: The columns cohere tightly around a single inferable focus: identifying attention-worthy incidents from their descriptions. Rather than a generic grab-bag or bare token counts, they form a layered structure -- textual severity signals (has_critical_keyword, contains_outage_signal), a domain segmentation facet (issue_type) with an associated volume dimension (issue_frequency_rank), and a synthesizing composite (attention_score). This is a sound predictor/facet set at a useful granularity that an analyst could act on (triage, prioritize, drill into high-score or outage-flagged incidents). Minor deductions: issue_frequency_rank appears to be a mechanical restatement of issue_type counts (redundant granularity), and attention_score's construction is opaque, so its analytical validity depends on how its inputs are combined -- otherwise it risks circular restatement of the other flags. These weaken structure_quality slightly but do not break the coherent focus.
